Hi everyone! I'm Scott Wesley, a PhD student based at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Canada. I usually work on quantum program semantics and program verification, but lately I have been trying to formalize some of my theorems in Lean. Along the way, I ended up formalizing some general theorems about matrices and ODE's that do not seem to be in mathlib. I haven't pushed anything to github yet, but here are some examples:

  • The solution to an autonomous linear ODE is a matrix exponential
  • Closed form solutions to exponentials of matrices with special properties
  • Properties of matrices (e.g., Hermitian unitary matrices are self-inverse)

I've been reading through the contribution guide, and it seems like these theorems would be in scope. I'd be happy to work with the community to contribute this work to mathlib, if it is of interest.

Thanks for taking the time to read this! - Scott
